# Design point P010

## Description

Repositories are maintained with a fixed floor of three replicas, while rendezvous hashing maps each repository ID to expected healthy hosting servers and adjusts placement as membership changes. Maintenance periodically removes accumulated loose objects from repository storage, reducing disk and lookup overhead across replicas.
